info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Education Enrollments Certificates-v3-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Certificates API allows users to retrieve information about certificates associated with student enrollments in educational programs. This API serves educational institutions, administrators, and developers who need to access, manage, and analyze student enrollment data. By using this endpoint, consumers can efficiently obtain a list of certificates that correspond to specific enrollments, streamlining processes such as verification and reporting. The API enhances the administrative capabilities of educational organizations by providing relevant insights on student certificates.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of an enrollment certificate. Useful for retrieving information such as the certificate status, date issued, and associated student information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve enrollment certificate details. The information requested can include various attributes related to certifications associated with enrollments.

ListEducationEnrollmentsCertificatesRequ.description: The request body for the GET operation regarding enrollments and certificates.

ListEducationEnrollmentsCertificatesResp.title: Certificate Retrieval Response

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the enrollment request.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the enrollment.

state.description: The current state of the enrollment process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the request.

ListEducationEnrollmentsCertificatesResp.description: This schema represents the response when retrieving certificate enrollment status. It includes the status of the request, a reference number, result ID, state, processing time, message, and audit information.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the enrollment request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the enrollment request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the enrollment request was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: This schema represents audit information related to the certificate enrollment request, including who created the request and when, as well as whether it was automated.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
